title: I've been building a browser sandbox where you wreck an entire city with superpowers (3 weeks of progress, playable now)
author: Roninteon
selftext:
Hey everyone! For the past 3 weeks I've been working on Rivas City, a 3D sandbox / beat 'em up that runs right in your browser, desktop only, no download needed. I'd love for you to try it and tell me what you think.

What is it?

An open island city that's all yours to wreck. You're a villain with real powers: fireballs, lightning, laser eyes, a mega beam, telekinesis and flight. Or just brawl with your fists. There are three modes:

Street Fight: survive waves of gangs, police and soldiers, picking an upgrade between waves.

Villain: the full sandbox. The more chaos you cause, the harder the city hunts you: police, SWAT, army, attack helicopters, and finally a superhero.

Zombies: night falls and the infected come in bigger and bigger rounds.

Almost everything is destructible. You can blow holes in walls, bring down floors, break windows by throwing people through them, and pull civilians out of buildings through the holes you make.

Tech stack

Plain JavaScript with ES modules (no framework, no bundler), with TypeScript being adopted gradually

Three.js for rendering

Rapier 3D for physics

Web Audio for synthesized sound

Procedural textures

About the development

This is about 3 weeks of work, and most of it was built with AI assistance. The tool I used most was Sonnet 5.5 on high effort. I steer the design and test the game myself; the AI does a lot of the heavy lifting on the code.

Please keep in mind: the game is in early development. Expect bugs, rough edges and things that aren't finished yet.

I'd really appreciate your feedback. What feels good, what feels broken, what would you like to see next? Every comment helps me decide what to work on.

Link: [https://roninteon.itch.io/rivas-city](https://roninteon.itch.io/rivas-city)

Thanks for reading, and have fun causing chaos!
